arch.title: Backend ↔ Frontend in 30 seconds
arch.backendBody: Python 3.11+ · FastAPI under /api/v1/ · Pydantic v2 · SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite + Alembic · structlog JSON + X-Request-Id. Mistral via httpx async (chat SSE streaming) + sync (embeddings/vision). No Mistral SDK.
arch.frontendBody: React 18 + strict TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + i18next + TanStack Query, @internal/ui components and @internal/design-tokens. The built React app is served by the backend at /.
steps: Settings tab → enter the Mistral key (stored in SQLite, app_config table).
Test the connection — lists the available Mistral models.
OCR / Vision tab → send an image/PDF, get the OCR text + description.
Data tab → view counters and reset tables if needed.

data.resetWarning: Irreversible operation. The Mistral configuration (app_config table) is preserved.
